# Ruhaan Kumar Web Design

> Custom website design and development for small businesses in Singapore. Websites from S$400, launched in about a week. Also offers launch and setup (domain, hosting, Google Business Profile, email) and social media automation.

## Services
- Template website: one of five industry designs (coaches and trainers, teachers, property agents, tradespeople, independent cafés), filled with the business's details. S$400 flat.
- Tailored template: a template with bigger changes such as extra sections, pages or features. S$500 to S$600.
- Custom website: designed from scratch, up to five pages. From S$750.
- Every package includes two rounds of changes.
- Hosting and launch: domain, hosting, Google Business Profile and professional email. S$50 to S$100.
- Social media automation: monthly content calendar with automatic publishing to Instagram and Facebook. Priced by quote.

## Who it is for
Freelancers and independent businesses in Singapore: coaches and trainers, teachers, property agents, tradespeople and independent cafés.
